description: Generate text embeddings via the local LLM server. Requires an embedding model to be loaded (e.g. Nomic Embed). Returns a vector representation of the input text for semantic search, similarity comparison, or RAG pipelines. Uses the OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint.

input.description: The text to embed. Can be a single string.

model.description: Embedding model ID. If omitted, uses whatever embedding model is loaded.

name: embed
